newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cotton output seen reaching 12.5 mln bales.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cotton output seen reaching 12.5 mln bales.

text.p: Pakistan's 1996/97 (July-June) cotton output is likely to soar to 12.5 million 375-lb bales from 9.94 million in 1995/96, the vice-chairman of the Pakistan Cotton Ginners Association said on Tuesday.

"The main reason for the expected higher production is sowing of cottonseed on 10 million acres (4.1 million hectares) for the 1996/97 crop, up from nine million in 1995/96," Omar Farooq Ehsan Chhani told Reuters.
"Higher prices of cotton in the domestic markets were a catalyst to farmers," said Chhani, speaking by telephone from Kot Addu in the cotton belt in Punjab province.
Commerce Minister Ahmed Mukhtar said last week that Pakistan would have a bumper cotton crop of more than 10 million bales, but gave no detailed estimate.
